messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **April, May, September, and October** are the sweet spots.

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny days (average high ~82 °F / 28 °C) and lower hotel rates after the spring break rush. |
| **May** | Still warm (highs ~84 °F / 29 °C), but the rainy season hasn’t fully kicked in yet, so you get plenty of sunshine. |
| **September** | Post‑summer crowds thin out, temperatures stay comfortable (highs ~83 °F / 28 °C), and you can snag better deals on flights and accommodations. |
| **October** | Mild, pleasant weather (highs ~81 °F / 27 °C) and the peak tourist season has ended, so you’ll find quieter beaches and lower prices. |

If you’re a big fan of surfing, the winter months (November–February) bring larger swells, but they also come with cooler temperatures (highs ~77 °F / 25 °C) and higher crowds. Conversely, July and August are the hottest (highs ~86 °F / 30 °C) and the busiest, so they’re usually the most expensive.

So, if you want a balance of great weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices, aim for **late spring or early fall**—April, May, September, or October.
